The lounge team noted an idea about handover notes, and thanks for your short note. We understand that your complaint concerns inconsistent support for your companion animal during transfer, including unclear instructions, limited coordination at the point of handoff, and the feeling that your concern was not handled with enough care.

Please accept our apology for that experience. Aurelia Skyways expects every contact with the Companion Animal Travel Desk to be calm, respectful, and practical, and your report shows that this standard was not met in this case. Our team will review the handover process with the staff involved and remind crews that animal travel notes must be read carefully and followed without delay. We also reinforce that each animal receives patient attention from trained staff, including during busy movements between the desk, lounge, and aircraft.

To help us improve, please keep any travel receipts, service notes, and written observations from the journey. If you are willing, send a clear account of what occurred from check-in through arrival, including where the breakdown in communication happened and what assistance was missing. This will allow us to compare the records with the crew report and address the service gap through the proper channel.

We are also updating our internal reminders so that the desk shares practical instructions in plain language and confirms the plan with the relevant crew before departure. When there is a transfer involving a pet, staff should be able to explain the steps calmly and provide support without making the traveler repeat the same concern several times. That is the level of care we expect from the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways.

Thank you for bringing this matter forward. We value the trust placed in us when a traveler is moving with a companion animal, and we will use your report to strengthen our service. Companion Animal Travel Desk
